description: Demolition of an existing garage and erection of an attached two storey dwelling with outbuilding to rear. Provision of refuse storage and parking to the front and cycle storage to the rear. Erection of a single storey rear extension, conversion of loft space involving hip to gable extension with rear dormer extension, front rooflights and erection of an outbuilding to rear garden to No. 4 Windborough Road.
decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved. Reason: To ensure that the extension harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the first floor and second floor windows on the rear elevations serving bathrooms/shower rooms shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall be non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed. These windows shall be permanently retained as such thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the privacy and residential amenities of neighbouring occupiers to comply with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment and SuDS Report prepared by Nimbus Engineering Consultants Ltds and dated May 2026. Prior to first occupation of the dwellingt, written confirmation that percolation testing to BRE365 has been undertaken and that the approved SuDS measures have been implemented as part of the development as built must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.  Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

All tree protection measures outlined in the Arboricultural Impact Assessment (Connick Tree Consultants, 1st May 2026), including the high-visibility welded mesh protective fencing around Tree T001, shall be erected prior to the commencement of any site works or demolition and shall be maintained until all construction works are complete. No storage of materials or site compound shall take place within the designated Construction Exclusion Zone (CEZ).Reason: To safeguard retained trees and preserve visual amenity to comply with Policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the commencement of development, a Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall confirm the purchase and allocation of 0.03 off-site habitat units (Low Distinctiveness) from a registered habitat bank to deliver a 10% net gain, together with details of on-site ecological enhancements (including bird/bat boxes and native planting). The approved measures shall be implemented prior to occupation and retained thereafter.Reason: To secure measurable biodiversity net gain and enhance nature conservation in accordance with Policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 26 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the first occupation of the dwelling hereby approved, the cycle storage facilities for both the new unit and the existing property (No. 4) as shown on Drawing No. J005195-DD-09 shall be fully provided and made available for use, and shall thereafter be permanently retained for cycle storage purposes only. In addition, prior to the first occupation of the dwelling, the covered refuse and recycling storage enclosures shown on the approved front garden layout shall be fully constructed and made available for use, and shall thereafter be retained permanently.Reason: To ensure adequate and clean bin storage facilities in the interests of visual amenity and public health, and to promote sustainable and active modes of transport, to comply with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies 28, 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The two off street car parking spaces shown on Drawing No. J005195-DD-09 utilising the single shared crossover shall be provided prior to the first occupation of the new dwelling and shall be permanently retained solely for the parking of vehicles associated with No. 4 and the new unit.Reason: To ensure adequate off-street parking provision and maintain highway safety to comply with Policy T6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no enlarged roof, dormer extensions, rooflights, or ground-floor extensions shall be erected on the new dwelling hereby approved without the prior written grant of planning permission.Reason: To prevent overdevelopment of the plot, safeguard visual amenity, and protect neighbouring privacy to comply with Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies 28 and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Safety Statement prepared by WS Planning dated April 2026. Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

The rating level of noise emitted by the Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) hereby permitted shall be at least 5db lower than the existing background noise level during any normal mode of operation. Measurements and assessments shall be made externally 1m from any window of a habitable room at the nearest residential facade in accordance with BS 4142:2014.Reason: To safeguard the residential amenities of nearby occupiers to comply with Policy 29 and Policy 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement (Version 0) prepared by Base Energy Ltd and dated 20 April 2026. Prior to first occupation of the dwelling ,' 'as-built' Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.  Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
